description:
Verify a single email's deliverability (syntax, DNS/MX, SMTP mailbox,
    disposable / role / catch-all detection, confidence score).

    Costs 1 credit for a billable result (valid/invalid/catch_all/disposable/do_not_mail),
    whether fresh or served from cache. `unknown` results are free. Requires an
    API key. Returns {success, credits_used, result}.
name: verify_email
